body.title: Both build prompts ask for the Insrc-Story trailer
body.summary: Add the trailer rule `Insrc-Story: {{epicHash}}/{{storyId}}` to the commit step of src/prompts/build/implement-task.md and render epicHash in src/daemon/steps/build-step/render.ts; add epicHash to StandaloneBuildSpec and the trailer rule to renderStandaloneImplementPrompt (src/daemon/steps/build-step/render.ts:183-199), supplied by its caller (src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/implement.ts:171). From this task on, every commit of this Story carries `Insrc-Story: b47dadc7cf0cccb1/S001` (written by hand until the installed daemon serves the new prompt).
acceptanceChecks: The rendered task prompt asks for `Insrc-Story: <epicHash>/<storyId>` with the Story's real epicHash and storyId.
The rendered no-plan standalone prompt asks for the same trailer with the standalone Story's epicHash.
The existing render and standalone-implement tests pass, updated only where they assert the commit step.
